Try this through QS:

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
At 3:15:
Minute hand: 15 × 6° = 90°
Hour hand: 3 × 30° + 15 × 0.5° = 97.5°
Difference: 97.5° − 90° = 7.5°
So the smaller angle is 7.5 degrees. 🎩🦆

messages.text: 🎩 Perfect, dear. That’s exactly the evidence we need. Close QS, send me the log, and we’ll see whether GPT actually passed through the new settling gate before finalizing.
